test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 50 men took a dip in a water tank 40 m long and 20 m broad on a religious day. If the average displacement of water by a man is 4 m³, then the rise in the water level in the tank will be:
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total volume of water displaced = **Total Men** × **Average Displacement per man**

Total Volume = 50 × 4 = 200 m³

Rise in water level = Total Volume ÷ Area of base = 200 ÷ (40 × 20)

Rise in level = 200 ÷ 800 = 0.25 m = 25 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 25 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length (L) = 40 m, Breadth (B) = 20 m, Number of men = 50, Average volume per man = 4 m³

**Formula Used:** Volume of water displaced = Volume of rectangular tank up to rise level = L × B × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01106475357320e906e901e0041e248ace2946550fb5eb1a7f4a46b05c57d0ab.png] 

⇒ Total volume of water displaced = 50 × 4 = 200 m³

⇒ Area of the tank base = Length × Breadth = 40 × 20 = 800 m²

⇒ Volume = Area × Rise in level (h)

⇒ 200 = 800 × h

⇒ h = 200 ÷ 800 = 0.25 m

⇒ h in cm = 0.25 × 100 = 25 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 25 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume Displacement Principle

When an object is submerged in a liquid, it displaces a volume of liquid equal to its own volume (Archimedes Principle). In a fixed container, this results in a rise in level h = Volume ÷ Base Area.

Unit Conversions

Always ensure units are consistent. 1 meter = 100 centimeters; 1 m³ = 1000 liters. Conversion from m to cm requires multiplying by 100.

Cuboid Formulas

Volume = Length × Breadth × Height. Total Surface Area = 2(lb + bh + hl). Lateral Surface Area = 2h(l + b).</p
